name: bodyweight standing biceps curl
description: A curl done with your own body resistance, such as pushing one hand against the other. It is a simple way to train the biceps without equipment.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
